{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any remaining non-numeric values
non_numeric_revenue = sales_df['revenue'].isna().sum()

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Calculate mean revenue for completed orders
mean_revenue_completed = completed_orders['revenue'].mean()

# Verify that the mean is computed only on valid numeric data
valid_revenue_count = completed_orders['revenue'].notna().sum()

non_numeric_revenue, valid_revenue_count, mean_revenue_completed"}
